title.zh: 李飞飞创业公司被苏姿丰550亿收购！世界模型最大交易落地
title.en: 李飞飞创业公司被苏姿丰550亿收购！世界模型最大交易落地

current_state.zh:
AMD已收购李飞飞创办的世界模型公司，交易金额约550亿元人民币（约合77亿美元），被称为世界模型领域迄今最大的一笔交易。李飞飞将加入AMD担任首席科学家。

这笔交易将一家领先的空间智能研究机构纳入大型芯片厂商内部，其创始人出任首席科学家，意味着世界模型研究与AI硬件战略正在更紧密地结合。

标题中的550亿元约合77亿美元。交易完成后，李飞飞的职务为AMD首席科学家。
current_state.en: AMD has acquired Fei-Fei Li's world-model startup in a ~55 billion RMB deal — the largest transaction in the world-model space to date — with Li set to join AMD as chief scientist.

updates.detailed_summary_en: AMD has acquired Fei-Fei Li's world-model startup in a ~55 billion RMB deal — the largest transaction in the world-model space to date — with Li set to join AMD as chief scientist.
updates.background_zh: 李飞飞是斯坦福大学教授，最为人熟知的是创建了ImageNet数据集；她创办了空间智能初创公司World Labs，该公司成立数月后估值即被报道超过10亿美元。世界模型是一类AI系统，能够构建环境的内在表征并预测环境在动作作用下如何变化，这一能力与机器人、自动驾驶和交互式视频生成相关。李飞飞在2025年11月的一篇文章中将空间智能称为AI的“下一个前沿”。
updates.background_en: Fei-Fei Li is a Stanford professor best known for creating ImageNet; she founded World Labs, a spatial-intelligence startup, which was reported to have reached a valuation above $1 billion within months of launching. World models are AI systems that build an internal representation of an environment and predict how it changes in response to actions, a capability relevant to robotics, autonomous driving and interactive video generation. Li has described spatial intelligence as AI's "next frontier" in a November 2025 essay.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这笔交易把世界模型研究集中到一家大型芯片厂商内部，关系到AI算力供给以及GPU相关叙事所关注的软硬件路线图；对加密市场而言，主要传导渠道是与去中心化AI/算力代币相关的情绪，而非直接的资产敞口。
updates.market_impact_en: The deal concentrates world-model research inside a large chipmaker, which bears on AI compute supply and the hardware-software roadmaps that GPU-adjacent narratives track; for crypto markets the main transmission channel is sentiment around decentralized AI/compute tokens rather than direct asset exposure.
